data.name: Query_DetailAdditionsFixedAssets
data.value:
select distinct FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeName, INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.NetAmount from INV_Item inner join FA_SET_AssetType on FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeID = INV_Item.EquipmentTypeID inner join FA_AssetInformation on FA_AssetInformation.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = FA_AssetInformation.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = FA_AssetInformation.PODetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = FA_AssetInformation.CompanyID inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID
where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate

data.name: Query_DisposalsOfFixedAssets
data.value:
--Declare @FromDate datetime = '2020-11-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-09-05 00:00:00:000' --Declare @CompanyID int = 2 --Declare @PeriodID int= 1
select t.AssetTypeName as AssetTypeName, t.Description, t.PurchaseDate , t.DocumentDate as SaleDate, SUM(Abs(t.TransactionQuantity)) as Qty, SUM(t.Cost) as Cost, SUM(t.OpeningDepreciation) as OpeningDepreciation ,sum(t.CurrentDepreciation) as CurrentDepreciation, SUM(t.OpeningDepreciation + t.CurrentDepreciation) as AsAtCost --AccumulatedDepreciation ,SUM(t.BookValue) as BookValue,SUM(t.Proceeds) as Proceeds,(isnull(SUM(t.Cost),0) - SUM(t.OpeningDepreciation + t.CurrentDepreciation)) as GainAndLoss ,t.Comments as Remarks from (
select FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeName,isnull(FA_AssetInformation.WrittenDownValue,0) as Cost, 0 as OpeningDepreciation ,isnull(FA_DepreciationProcess.WDV,0) as CurrentDepreciation,Isnull(FA_AssetInformation.WrittenDownValue,0) as BookValue ,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0) as Proceeds,INV_Item.Description,FA_AssetInformation.PurchaseDate,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0) as TransactionQuantity,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments
from FA_AssetInformation INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = FA_AssetInformation.ItemID INNER JOIN FA_SET_AssetType ON FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeID = FA_AssetInformation.AssetTypeID AND FA_SET_AssetType.CompanyID = FA_AssetInformation.CompanyID AND FA_SET_AssetType.Status = 1 inner JOIN FA_DepreciationProcess ON FA_DepreciationProcess.AssetIdentityID = FA_AssetInformation.AssetInfoID AND FA_SET_AssetType.CompanyID = FA_DepreciationProcess.CompanyID AND FA_DepreciationProcess.Status = 1
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid = INV_Item.Itemid inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath = '/Sales/Dispatch_frm.aspx')
where FA_DepreciationProcess.CompanyID in @CompanyID and isDisposed = 1 And (FA_DepreciationProcess.DepreciatedFrom between @FromDate AND @ToDate) )t group by t.AssetTypeName,t.Description,t.PurchaseDate,t.DocumentDate,t.TransactionQuantity,t.Comments

data.name: Query_FADisposalReport
data.value:
Select SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate,SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.Description, (FA_AssetInformation.tagprefix+'-'+FA_AssetInformation.tagnumber) as TagName, SET_Location.LocationName,set_costcenter.CostCenterName
,isnull((Select SUM(FADP.DepreciationAmount) from FA_DepreciationProcess FADP INNER JOIN FA_AssetInformation FAI ON FADP.AssetIdentityID = FAI.AssetInfoID and FADP.CompanyID= FAI.CompanyID where FAI.TagPrefix=FA_AssetInformation.TagPrefix and FAI.TagNumber=FA_AssetInformation.TagNumber ),0) AS DisposValue
From SAL_DispatchHeader Inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID left Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader On Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID left Join Inv_StockTransactionDetail On Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 inner JOIN FA_AssetInformation ON FA_AssetInformation.AssetInfoID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.AssetInfoID AND FA_AssetInformation.Status=1 left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID inner join set_costcenter on set_costcenter.costcenterid = SAL_DispatchHeader.CostCentreID
INNER JOIn SET_Company ON FA_AssetInformation.CompanyID=SET_Company.CompanyId AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_CompanyPeriod ON SET_CompanyPeriod.CompanyID=SET_Company.CompanyId AND SET_CompanyPeriod.status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Period on SET_Period.PeriodID = SET_CompanyPeriod.PeriodID
Where SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between @FromDate AND @ToDate {0}

data.name: Query_SummaryOfDisposal
data.value:
select (AssetTypeName) as AssetTypeName,sum(Cost) as Cost,sum(Quantity) as Quantity,sum(AsAtCost) as AsAtCost,sum(BookValue) as BookValue,sum(Proceeds) as Proceeds,sum(GainAndLoss) as GainAndLoss from (
select FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeName ,sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) as Cost,sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity, 0 as OpeningDepreciation, 0 as CurrentDepreciation ,0 as AsAtCost,0 as BookValue,0 as Proceeds,0 as GainAndLoss from INV_Item inner join FA_SET_AssetType on FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeID = INV_Item.EquipmentTypeID inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid = INV_Item.Itemid inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx') where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate = group by FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeName
union all
select FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeName,0 as Cost,sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity, isnull(Sum(FA_DepreciationProcess.WDV),0) as OpeningDepreciation, ISnull(sum(FA_AssetInformation.CurrentValue),0) as CurrentDepreciation ,sum(FA_AssetInformation.WrittenDownValue) as AsAtCost,0 as BookValue,0 as Proceeds,0 as GainAndLoss from FA_AssetInformation INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = FA_AssetInformation.ItemID INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail on FA_AssetInformation.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = FA_AssetInformation.CompanyID INNER JOIN FA_SET_AssetType ON FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeID = FA_AssetInformation.AssetTypeID AND FA_SET_AssetType.CompanyID = FA_AssetInformation.CompanyID AND FA_SET_AssetType.Status = 1 inner JOIN FA_DepreciationProcess ON FA_DepreciationProcess.AssetIdentityID = FA_AssetInformation.AssetInfoID AND FA_SET_AssetType.CompanyID = FA_DepreciationProcess.CompanyID AND FA_DepreciationProcess.Status = 1
where FA_DepreciationProcess.CompanyID = @CompanyID And (FA_DepreciationProcess.DepreciatedFrom between @FromDate AND @ToDate Or FA_DepreciationProcess.DepreciatedUpTo between @FromDate AND @ToDate) group by FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeName
) as tab group by AssetTypeName

data.name: Query_SummaryOfDisposals
data.value:
--Declare @FromDate datetime = '2020-11-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-09-05 00:00:00:000' --Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int= 1
select t.AssetTypeName as AssetTypeName , SUM(t.Cost) as Cost, SUM(t.OpeningDepreciation) as OpeningDepreciation ,sum(t.CurrentDepreciation) as CurrentDepreciation, SUM(t.OpeningDepreciation + t.CurrentDepreciation) as AsAtCost --AccumulatedDepreciation ,SUM(t.BookValue) as BookValue,SUM(t.Proceeds) as Proceeds,(isnull(SUM(t.Cost),0) - SUM(t.OpeningDepreciation + t.CurrentDepreciation)) as GainAndLoss
from (
select FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeName,isnull(FA_AssetInformation.WrittenDownValue,0) as Cost, 0 as OpeningDepreciation ,isnull(FA_DepreciationProcess.WDV,0) as CurrentDepreciation,Isnull(FA_AssetInformation.WrittenDownValue,0) as BookValue ,isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0) as Proceeds
from FA_AssetInformation INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = FA_AssetInformation.ItemID INNER JOIN FA_SET_AssetType ON FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeID = FA_AssetInformation.AssetTypeID AND FA_SET_AssetType.CompanyID = FA_AssetInformation.CompanyID AND FA_SET_AssetType.Status = 1 inner JOIN FA_DepreciationProcess ON FA_DepreciationProcess.AssetIdentityID = FA_AssetInformation.AssetInfoID AND FA_SET_AssetType.CompanyID = FA_DepreciationProcess.CompanyID AND FA_DepreciationProcess.Status = 1
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid = INV_Item.Itemid inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath = '/Sales/Dispatch_frm.aspx')
where FA_DepreciationProcess.CompanyID in @CompanyID and isDisposed = 1 And (FA_DepreciationProcess.DepreciatedFrom between @FromDate AND @ToDate) )t group by t.AssetTypeName
